name: Durak Severnyi (Northern Durak)
description: Durak Severnyi (Northern Fool) is an atmospheric and high-stakes variant of the Russian card game Durak, primarily played in the Northern regions of Russia and Siberia. While it follows the standard Podkidnoy (throw-in) mechanics for the majority of the game, it contains a legendary 'sting in the tail': a late-game trump suit shift. By hiding the final trump identity until the very last card is drawn, Durak Severnyi forces players to maintain a balanced hand of all suits, as a dominant lead in the initial trump suit can instantly turn into a liability at the game's climax.

content.text: Durak Severnyi (Northern Fool) is an atmospheric and high-stakes variant of the Russian card game Durak, primarily played in the Northern regions of Russia and Siberia. While it follows the standard Podkidnoy (throw-in) mechanics for the majority of the game, it contains a legendary 'sting in the tail': a late-game trump suit shift. By hiding the final trump identity until the very last card is drawn, Durak Severnyi forces players to maintain a balanced hand of all suits, as a dominant lead in the initial trump suit can instantly turn into a liability at the game's climax.

Originating in the Arkhangelsk and Vologda regions, this variant reflected the unpredictable and harsh nature of the Northern Russian climate. It was designed to prevent 'trump hoarding'â€”a common strategy in standard Durak that can make the endgame predictable.
2-6 players. Best with 3-4 to ensure the Secret Trump phase is reached.
36-card Russian pack (6, 7, 8, 9, 10, J, Q, K, A).

1. Each player is dealt 6 cards.
2. One card is placed FACE-DOWN in the center.
3. The next card is placed FACE-UP on top of it (The Initial Trump Suit).
4. The stock is placed on top of these two cards.

items.text: Secret Trump (Trump Shift): After the face-up trump is drawn as second-to-last from the stock, the player who draws the final face-down card reveals it; that card's suit becomes the new trump for the rest of the game; the former trump becomes an ordinary suit. If the face-down card is the same suit as the initial trump, nothing changes.
Other: No further documented variants in primary sources.
